description: Point this checkout at a database branch, or back at the main database (Admins only). With no name, reports which branch is active. Writes a local pointer, never `.env`.

name.description: Branch to switch to. Omit to report the active branch.

off.description: Switch back to the main database instead of a branch.

project.description: The project to act on: a registered project's name (rebase_project_list), or a Rebase Cloud project's slug or id. Optional when the session's directory is linked to the intended project. Refused when it names a different project than the directory's link.

name: rebase_db_branch_switch
